answer: A concrete Sybil defense requires every agent to lock a non-fungible onyx bond equal to 100 units of compute credit before it can broadcast. The bond is released only after the agent maintains a publicly verifiable lantern of continuous service for two epochs and receives a unique quill signature from established validators. Attackers seeking many identities must purchase and immobilize large amounts of scarce onyx credit for each fake, while any detected inconsistency in the lantern record causes the entire bond to be slashed, multiplying the economic cost of fabrication.
